x-gts-traits.intent: A sortable column's header button, toggling that column's sort state and showing its current direction.
typical_uses: The header render function of a sortable column in a DataTable

dont_use_when.situation: A standalone action button with no column to sort

mounted_in.container: a column's `header` render function - `header: ({ column }) => <DataTableSortButton column={column} />`
mounted_in.note: TanStack Table's `header` is a plain function prop on `ColumnDef`, not a kit component, so there is no component this could reference. It is also where the live `column` instance comes from: outside that call there is nothing to pass.

invariants.text: `column` must be the live `Column` instance a `ColumnDef`'s own `header` render function receives - toggling sort calls `column.toggleSorting()` directly, so this only makes sense mounted inside that render function, not constructed by hand elsewhere.

anti_patterns.dont: Use DataTableSortButton outside a column's header render function
anti_patterns.instead: For a plain action button with no column to sort, use Button directly

untyped.claim: column is a live @tanstack/react-table Column instance, generic over TData and TValue
untyped.reason: `Column<DataTableFeatures, TData, TValue>` carries methods (`toggleSorting`, `getIsSorted`) and internal state, not a serializable shape, and two of its three type arguments are the caller's own type parameters - neither a live object nor a generic has a JSON Schema representation. It is handed in by TanStack Table's own render call; a consumer never constructs one.

untyped.claim: children is a React node - the column's label
untyped.reason: `ReactNode`, so an element is as valid as a string. Required, because a sort button with no label is a button whose only content is a direction arrow.

untyped.claim: DataTableSortButton composes the kit's own Button internally
untyped.reason: It renders a `<Button variant="ghost" size="sm">` around its own label and a trailing sort-arrow icon - this is internal composition (JSX in DataTableSortButton's own render body), not a props-type heritage relationship, so none of Button's own props reach this contract: DataTableSortButtonProps declares `column`/`children`/`className` itself and extends nothing.

untyped.claim: its only real mount point is a column's header render function, which has no contract of its own
untyped.reason: TanStack Table's `header: ({ column }) => ...` is a plain function prop on `ColumnDef`, not a kit component, so `mounted_in` above states it as a container outside the kit rather than referencing a component that does not exist.

bad.title: Constructed outside any column header
bad.why: Outside a column's own `header` render function there is no live `Column` instance to pass - `column` is not something a consumer constructs by hand, it is handed in by TanStack Table's own render call.
